name: Juan Vargas
page_title: Juan Vargas' Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Democratic for U.S. House (CA) - District 52

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "As the one-year mark of the #DobbsDecision comes to a close, I promise to double down on the fight for #ReproductiveFreedom for ALL women. Abortion IS healthcare — and it’s a decision that should be made by a woman and her doctor, NOT politicians."

"Earlier today, I joined regional leaders in San Diego to denounce #SCOTUS’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. We must codify Roe into federal law so women can make their own reproductive health care decisions. The Senate must pass the Women’s Health Protection Act."

"Overturning #RoevWade was fundamentally wrong & jeopardized millions of women’s access to reproductive care. The Senate must pass the #WomensHealthProtectionAct to make Roe the law of the land once again."
"Roe v. Wade was the law of the land. Today's Supreme Court decision is fundamentally wrong and extremely disappointing, impacting millions of women across the country. My full statement is below."

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "I #StandWithNancy because I know she will fight for families, workers, veterans, and against GOP attacks on Medicare."
"On Sunday, we celebrate the 52nd anniversary of #Medicare & #Medicaid—crucial programs for families that will be at risk under #Trumpcare."

"Over and over, the President has said he will terminate the payroll tax if reelected, which would defund #SocialSecurity, ending benefits by 2023. We can't and won't let this happen! #SaveOurSocialSecurityNow #HandsOffSocialSecurity"
Voted in favor of HR 826 "Expressing Disapproval of the Trump administration's harmful actions towards Medicaid"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "I was delighted to connect with the wonderful community at the Bay Terraces Community & Senior Center! It was a pleasure to meet with my constituents and engage in meaningful discussions around housing affordability and important issues in #CA52"
"It was an honor to address @NAHREP Policy Summit attendees last night to share my work fighting for more affordable housing."
"I’m leading housing initiatives in Congress to help communities of color gain more equitable access to homeownership. Everyone deserves to own a home! #CHCISUMMIT"

"Passing #BuildBackBetter could end homelessness, reduce the racial wealth gap, and create equitable access to affordable housing. Everyone deserves a safe, secure, and affordable place to live. #ShowHousingLove"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "In #CA52, ACA enrollees are saving $1,000 on premiums thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act. Average premiums in the district were $1,890, but without the IRA, they'd have surged 58% to $2,900. Affordable healthcare matters!"

"Inflation Reduction Act dollars at work! Recently, @EPA announced $250 million available in planning grants under the $5 billion Climate Pollution Reduction Grant program, helping governments confront climate pollution in their communities."

"More people signed up for #healthcare thanks to increased federal subsidies from the Inflation Reduction Act and California's new cost-sharing program You can still enroll until midnight, tonight, Feb 9th for coverage!"
"Thank you to the Inflation Reduction Act that will save Seniors money across California when Medicare negotiates to lower drug prices!"

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "Black & Latino Americans owe more on average compared to white borrowers. Canceling up to $20K in student loan debt is a step toward racial & economic justice. #CancelStudentDebt"
"Student loan payments are meant to resume on May 1. @POTUS can & should #CancelStudentDebt!"

"Student loan payments restart on October 1st! Approximately 1 in 5 student borrowers will struggle with student debt repayments. That’s over 8 million borrowers. Our borrowers deserve student debt relief. #StudentDebtRelief."

"The pause on federal student loan repayments is extended through May 1, 2022. This will help millions of financially vulnerable Americans who are unable to resume payments. Now let’s go a step further and #CancelStudentDebt for good."

positions.question: Do you support expanding paid family AND/OR medical leave benefits (e.g. maternity leave)?

evidence.text: "#Paidleavemeans all working people – no matter where they live or work – have time to care for their own health and their families. It's time to create more equal workplaces for everyone by guaranteeing paid family and medical leave in the United States. #FMLA25"
"Happy to take a step towards gender equity today by cosponsoring the #FAMILYAct to give workers *paid* family & medical leave."

"In 1993, the Family and Medical Leave Act transformed lives across our nation. 26 years later, millions of workers are still forced to choose between putting food on the table or taking care of a loved one. We need the #FAMILYAct now."

"There is strong and growing demand for #paidleave that promotes gender and economic equality and strengthens businesses and our economy. The #FAMILYAct would set a national standard and advance the FMLA’s vision of more equitable and family-friendly workplaces. #FMLA25"

positions.question: Should the government be able to regulate the cost of prescription drugs?

evidence.text: ".@HouseDemocrats have put #PeopleOverPolitics to lower health care costs. We’ve lowered prescription drug prices, including capping insulin at $35 a month for seniors on Medicare"

"Millions of Americans are struggling to keep up with the rapidly rising cost of prescription drugs. Last year, nearly 20% skipped doses were due to the high costs alone. I am working with @housedems #ForThePeople to fix this broken system. #ProtectOurCare"

"No one should have to ration insulin because they can't afford their prescription. I Voted in favor of the #AffordableInsulinNow Act so the more than 37 million Americans with diabetes will never have to ration life-saving medication again."
"Thank you to the Inflation Reduction Act that will save Seniors money across California when Medicare negotiates to lower drug prices!"

positions.question: Do you support requiring immigrants to return to their country of origin before they are eligible for citizenship, regardless of their immigration status?

evidence.text: "DACA recipients are our students, teachers, friends & neighbors. They deserve a pathway to citizenship. Let’s pass the Dream Act NOW! #HomeIsHere"
"DREAMers are our neighbors, our children's classmates, and members of our military. We must pass the DREAM Act to #ProtectDREAMers."

"Dreamers deserve the same access to opportunities offered to other Americans. Today, I introduced the #HomeownershipforDreamersAct to ensure that Dreamers remain eligible for certain federal mortgages and home loans."

"Today’s announcement by the Biden Administration to extend healthcare to Dreamers is a massive step in the right direction. I applaud this effort! I hope to continue seeing further advancements for America’s Dreamers — like codifying their access to home loans backed by the FHA."
